_doc: DEEPLINK verified matrix (2026-07-07, DEEPLINK-2A/2B). THE kill-switch for every operator-facing betslip link on /m: a book renders its single-leg 'open in <book>' anchor ONLY when enabled=true, and composed multi-leg slip links ONLY when enabled=true AND multiStatus is 'confirmed' or 'verified'. ALL BOOKS SHIP DISABLED — the operator flips each book to enabled:true after a real phone tap proves the link opens the right slip (record the verdict in OPERATOR_SESSION_LOG). {state} placeholders (BetMGM/BetRivers) substitute from the per-book state field — a link with an unfilled placeholder NEVER renders. multiStatus values: 'confirmed' (official docs — BetMGM comma-combo), 'verified' (operator phone-tap passed), 'unverified' (template exists, untested — composition BLOCKED), 'none' (no link surface — Fanatics, record-only). Matrix empty/disabled = no links anywhere; the slip tray and bet recording work regardless (recording NEVER depends on linking). Source doctrine: docs/research/2026-07-07-multileg-betslip-links.md + .scratch/deeplink_probe.txt.
